Chace Crawford has become widely known in the last few years thanks to his role as The Deep in the Prime Video superhero series The Boys, but he was around as a prominent actor in Hollywood long before that. All the way back in 2005, Crawford starred in the cult classic fantasy movie The Covenant, with other stars such as Sebastian Stan and Taylor Kitsch. The movie holds a mere 4% from critics on Rotten Tomatoes, but it’s found an audience in the years since its release on various streaming platforms. Crawford is also attached to star in a new football series, The Land, which is coming soon to Hulu. The series was written and created for TV by Dan Fogelman, who penned every episode of This Is Us and the recent Hulu sci-fi thriller, Paradise.

Hardcore Glee fans will also recall that Chace Crawford featured in the 100th episode of the show, along with other stars who were brought back for roles such as Gwyneth Paltrow. Fans were taken aback a few weeks ago when Ryan Murphy announced that he had finished writing the script for a Glee reboot and even talked to some original cast members about returning, but nothing concrete was in development yet beyond the script. During a recent interview with Collider at FanX in Salt Lake City, Collider’s Maggie Lovitt asked Crawford about his brief time on the show and if there’s anything he would like to see from the reboot, to which he said, “I don’t know, actually.” Explaining how his appearance on the show came to be, he told Collider:

“I was friends with Ryan [Murphy] and he asked me to come in and do the 100th episode. I just remember they did a bunch of journey stuff that I loved. They could probably do that song 'Happy.' I could see them doing that. I have no idea, though. They’d probably be doing Sabrina Carpenter songs, right? I’m not too steeped into all that, but that’s good.”
